'''Orsis Orbital Station''' ('''OOS''') was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orsis]] in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], a small [[Skirmish on Orsis Orbital Station|skirmish]] was fought there, which included the young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], and [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]] and his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].
